purpose: Use / knowledge-enhancement log slice (Marathon R11 lane BA; Constantopoulos et al. 2009, DCC&U, IJDC 4(1) — pattern only). One appended line per filed-back use event: {kind: 'use-event', date: YYYY-MM-DD, page: the synthesis/answer/annotation filed back, use_kind: one of synthesis/answer/annotation, sources: [source page paths, at least one], supports: [page paths], contradicts: [page paths], note}. A page may not appear in both supports and contradicts, and a page may not list itself as a source. Append-only; named-but-absent pages are reported dangling, not an error of record. Maintained with scripts/wiki_use_log.py. This header line is the only line until an operator records a use event — seeded empty-but-valid.
